title: Create a hello world HTTP server
description:
Create a simple Node.js HTTP server in server.js that:
- Listens on port 3000
- Returns 'Hello World' for GET /
- Returns 404 for other routes
- Include a package.json with a start script

title: Write a fibonacci function with tests
description:
Create a file called fib.js with:
- A function fibonacci(n) that returns the nth fibonacci number
- Handle edge cases (n=0, n=1, negative numbers)

Create a file called fib.test.js with tests that verify:
- fibonacci(0) === 0
- fibonacci(1) === 1
- fibonacci(10) === 55
- fibonacci(-1) throws an error

title: Create a README for the project
description: Write a README.md that documents the project structure, how to run the server, and how to run the tests.
